To: Comensura Limited
Subject: Contract IKEN 011240 - Managed Services for Temporary Agency Resources (Call-Off Contract under the ESPO MSTAR4 Framework Agreement 653F/23 dated 11 April 2023) - arrangements at vesting day

Dear supplier,

Our register shows that contract IKEN 011240 (Managed Services for Temporary Agency Resources (Call-Off Contract under the ESPO MSTAR4 Framework Agreement 653F/23 dated 11 April 2023)) with Guildford Borough Council ends on 2027-04-14, which is 13 days after the vesting day of the new West Surrey authority (2027-04-01). The register states a contract value of GBP 8,500,000.

Ahead of vesting day we need to agree one of: novation of this contract to the new authority, a short extension to align with the successor arrangements, or planned expiry. Please confirm your preferred route and any conditions by return.

draft.title: CTS harmonisation: Woking, Guildford
draft.text:
Council Tax Support: where Woking and Guildford differ.
Of 9 clauses compared, 4 differ and 5 agree.
- Maximum backdating (weeks): Woking 26 (6 months, with continuous good cause) (p.102); Guildford 4 (one calendar month, with continuous good cause) (p.100).
- Capital limit (GBP) above which no support is paid: Woking 10,000 (p.32); Guildford 6,000 (p.49).
- Valuation bands excluded from the scheme: Woking none (bands F-H claim, capped at Band D) (p.36); Guildford F, G and H (p.49).
- Minimum weekly award (GBP): Woking 5.00 (p.107); Guildford 10.00 (p.55).
Day-one check on 8 SYNTHETIC residents: 4 would get a different answer depending on which legacy scheme applied.
The new authority must adopt one working-age scheme before the first bills of 2027/28; these are the clauses the decision has to settle. Every value above cites a page of the published scheme.

artifacts.title: Day-one brief
artifacts.text:
Day-one brief for Woking, Guildford, Waverley - 3 of 3 checks run, planned by rules.
1. Contracts (Woking, Guildford, Waverley): 173 contracts end within 180 days of vesting day with no extension date recorded past it, stated value GBP 22,671,525; 45 of those suppliers are also paid by another council; held for approval: draft-3.
2. Suppliers (Woking, Guildford, Waverley): 229 supplier pairs shared, GBP 34,848,449 combined spend; 216 similar-name pairs awaiting a human decision; 1 pair(s) resolved using remembered human decision(s) mem-1.
3. Council Tax Support (Woking, Guildford): 4 of 9 Council Tax Support clauses differ; 4 of 8 SYNTHETIC test residents would be treated differently on day one; held for approval: draft-4.
Remembered human decisions applied: mem-1.
Held for approval, nothing sent: draft-3 (IKEN 011240 Managed Services for Temporary Agency Resources (Call-Off Contract under the ESPO MSTAR4 Framework Agreement 653F/23 dated 11 April 2023)); draft-4 (CTS harmonisation: Woking, Guildford).
Numbers come from the councils' own published files; each row carries a provenance id.

agents.name: Router
agents.role: Classifies a free-text request into a supported flow, extracts councils and parameters, or returns a structured unsupported error

agents.name: Planner
agents.role: Decides which checks a broad question needs (NVIDIA Nemotron proposes the plan in live mode; rules in sample mode), delegates them, assesses each result and revises the plan

agents.name: Critic
agents.role: Validates provenance and thresholds on every result; rejects and returns work that does not clear the bar (one real bounce when needed)

agents.name: Writer
agents.role: Drafts briefings and letters from the evidence table (NVIDIA Nemotron via Meterless Nightshift; deterministic template in sample mode)

agents.name: Researcher
agents.role: Runs federated SQL against the data layer (Zetaris live, cached council files in sample mode) and returns rows with provenance

agents.name: Resolver
agents.role: Normalises supplier names, scores cross-council matches, applies remembered decisions and Companies House identity; marks what still needs a human

agents.name: ApprovalGate
agents.role: Holds every draft for human approval and records human confirmations of supplier matches; no action is ever taken autonomously

agents.name: Memory
agents.role: Meterless H-MEM: recalls earlier human decisions (supplier matches, approvals) and stores new ones with provenance
